data.content_ref: inline:0e26d6be54fd reduces to SRC_006 (state of the theory): the problem of connecting an isolated artifact to its neighbourhood is reducible to the theory's own self-description of what it currently holds, because the state document defines the epistemic landscape — what artifacts exist, what they claim, and what relations are meaningful — from which substantive connections must be derived. Connection-building is an operation on the theory's declared state. REFUTED IF the state document is purely descriptive (a snapshot with no normative force on what connections are permissible), or if connections can be validly proposed using information entirely outside what the state document records.
